description: §38.10.2 — an `onclient:*` call expression with more than one argument fires E-CHANNEL-005. The first argument names the binding for the WS event object; a second argument has nothing to bind to. The S458 origin shape: `onclient:open=onOpen(x, 1)` compiled at exit 0 to `(x) => { onOpen(x, 1) }`.
rationale: §38.10.2 (S458 ruling item 1): the call expression in an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL carry at most one argument; more than one SHALL emit E-CHANNEL-005, the rule §38.6.1 states for `onserver:message`.
